glosses: ally (a person, group, or state (etc) which is associated with another for a common cause; one united to another by treaty or common purpose; a confederate)
ally (a person, group, concept (etc) which is associated with another as a helper; a supporter; an auxiliary)
ally (a man who supports as a feminist)

examples.text: Quiero ser tu aliado, no tu enemigo.
examples.en: I want to be your ally, not your enemy.

examples.text: Los aliados de tu padre no son solamente sus amigos.
examples.en: Your father's supporters are not limited to his friends.

examples.text: Las fuerzas aliadas atacaban desde el oeste.
examples.en: Allied forces were attacking from the west.

examples.text: Tom es mi aliado en la compañía.
examples.en: Tom is my ally at the company.
